C0204.title: Changsha County Police Dismantle Online Click Farm Ring Involving Over 40 Million Yuan
C0204.summary: Hunan CPPCC News reported that the Changsha County Public Security Bureau investigated a click-farming and fake-reputation case. The case reflects how online water-army services provide paid fake traffic through metric inflation, comment control, reposts, likes, and comments, potentially affecting product reputation, platform ranking, and consumer judgment, and it highlights local police enforcement against online water-army and click-farming activity. Platform governance should monitor abnormal review growth, clusters of low-quality accounts, and short-term merchant ranking swings.
